scope: Phase 2 opt-in internal static compiler pipeline on local CPU

derivation.latency: max(original approved ceiling, 1.25 * max(full-pipeline p95, component-observation total p95)), rounded upward to a reviewable boundary
derivation.memory: max(original approved ceiling, 1.25 * measured tracemalloc peak), rounded upward to a binary reviewable boundary
derivation.reason: the original budget compared a complete import/pass/lower/verify pipeline against approximately twice legacy planning cost and was not compositionally attainable
derivation.claim_boundary: internal regression budget only; not a public SLA or throughput claim

additional_gates.semantic_parity: unchanged from the original Phase 2 budget
additional_gates.determinism: exact output identity and pipeline digest across repeated runs
additional_gates.gradient: forward and gradient parity for every parameter-rewriting pass
additional_gates.default_runtime_regression: zero new-path imports or work without explicit internal opt-in
additional_gates.budget_changes: require new measured evidence and owner review; never auto-update to pass CI
